title: Random forest on blood counts separates EBV-associated HLH from mononucleosis in children
summary: Using blood counts within 24 hours of admission from 4,871 children, a random forest reached AUC 0.993 internally and 0.971 (95% CI 0.949-0.992) in an external validation group of 2,023 patients from a second campus. Prevalence of EBV-HLH differed between campuses (18.29% versus 4.25%). The study is retrospective within one hospital system.
ai_technology: Random forest chosen among thirteen ML algorithms, interpreted with SHAP
organization: Children’s Hospital of Chongqing Medical University

evidence.tested: External validation on the second campus of the same hospital.

source_review.scope: Abstract and Europe PMC full-text Methods/Results excerpts read. Publisher version not otherwise accessed. Author affiliations from OpenAlex metadata.
